newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT - BTPs to languish in range below 131.00.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT - BTPs to languish in range below 131.00.

text.p: September BTP futures on LIFFE are likely to remain trapped in a range on Thursday, with little momentum or strong chart signals to spark activity, technical analysts said.
Analysts said they expected a period of consolidation below 131.00 with little impetus either way.

"Trade looks vulnerable under 131.00 and we really need a clear break back above there to put the bulls in control but equally the downside looks limited as well," said Louise Jones, fixed income analyst at Technical Data here.
By 0850 GMT, the contract was down 0.08 at 130.40.
Jones placed initial resistance around 130.77 from a a trendline drawn off the contract high of May 21 and Wednesday's high of 130.88, but said this would not be particularly strong.
Analysts at UBS Futures & Options Ltd here said they expected consolidation below 131.00 and looked for first good support at or just under 130.00.
Jones pegged first supports at intra-day levels of 130.22,24 and sketchy support below there at 129.90,95.
But she said: "Levels like this are fairly academic as I can't see the market rallying out of fairly tight ranges."
UBS analysts said it would take a drop and close below 129.00 to violate the current uptrend.

Richard Adcock, manager of technical research at HSBC Futures here, said in a research note: "...we expect a period of consolidation to see corrections towards 130.00 where buying opportunities will be offered looking for attempts to breach the supply over 131.00."
By 0914 GMT, the September Eurolira future was down two basis points at 93.40.
